Standard: The interior lighting system provides lighting for crewmembers, passengers, and ground crew in occupied areas (e.g., crew stations, control stations, cargo compartment, loading and ramp areas, passageways, passenger seating area(s), and avionics bays). Lighting will be IAW MIL-STD-3009, General Lighting for Crew Stations and Compartments table. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Test.
(1) Ground test: Test lighting to ensure that illumination meets MIL-STD-3009, General Lighting for Crew Stations and Compartments table.
